description: Shared translation glossary and locale mapping spanning Host JSONs (rust/assets/locale/*.json), Desktop Rust string tables (client/protocol/desktop-config/src/strings/*.rs), and Android XML resources (client/app/src/main/res/values*/). Seeded from verified identical translations across surfaces.

host_legacy_missing.note: Frozen pre-Wave-5.2 host JSON fallback keys so `tools/i18n.py check` strictly blocks any new missing host translation or regression while passing on the existing tree. `couch_menu.*` is intentionally en+de only per rust/host/stream/src/locale.rs. Use `--strict-host` to report legacy debt.
